limitations: Reviewed complete landfarming and delivery per kilogram of average municipal wastewater sludge containing 97% water. A source waste reference of -1 kg and a generated treatment-service reference of +1 kg require factor -1, preserving both treatment demand and genuine signed credits. Retain every source biosphere row: 44 rows in 3.10–3.12 and 45 in 3.9/3.9.1, including legacy soil carbon. These are 43 or 44 physical releases and one separately marked waste-accounting indicator. Same-UUID Calcium, Sodium and Strontium label refinements preserve their original receiving compartments, units and masses; no native ionic-metal proxy is inferred. Only that indicator may be omitted with warning when unavailable. Native physical gaps require strict refusal or explicit permissive retention of unlinked physical rows; no ionic-metal or receiving-compartment proxy is added. Keep the exact canonical definitions, signed quantities, units, air and groundwater water releases, and 0.00097087 m3 of mechanical vacuum-tanker service per kg wet sludge. Do not normalize to dry matter, multiply by 97%, or derive a density correction. The complete Swiss mechanical service includes pumping, spreading, fuel, tractor, tanker and shed but explicitly excludes sludge production and sludge releases. Its geography, fuel demand, travel, vintage and 5 m3 equipment differ from the global machinery mix, including 24.7 m3 North American equipment. Preserve the markets' original treatment and separate freight coefficients. Regional all-sizes heavy-road freight uses the reviewed complete RER heavy-diesel fleet, with explicit regional, EURO-class, load and Swiss-2020 fleet-share limitations. Swiss rail retains the exact source electric/filtered-diesel shares through reviewed complete CH rail services; energy intensity, shunting, assets and vintage differ. Add no second spreading, transport, vehicle, infrastructure or energy credit. Preserve caller-owned quantities, uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions. Internal source parameter formulas and component uncertainty are not reconstructed. Only the enumerated cut-off profiles are approved; unknown profiles and consequential routes remain unsupported. No reverse correspondence is inferred and LCIA equivalence is not established.
